summary: API-GW retry spin causes upstream GPU memory fragmentation and elevated 5xx rate
description: Issue summary: ClarionAI observed a sudden elevation in 5xx errors (502/503) for inference and embedding routes starting 2026-03-12 09:10 UTC. Impact: customer experiencing ~30% error rate increase for calls to redwood-rlhf-13b and batch embedding workflows; requests spike at p95 latency and many inflight hedged retries are visible. Environment: production (us-east-1) serving cluster using dedicated capacity. Observed behavior suggests API-GW retry/hedged-retry loop amplified traffic to runtimes, exhausting keepalive slots and contributing to GPU memory fragmentation and eventual runtime OOMs/crash-restarts.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use ClarionAI test tenant with parallelism=40 and hedgedRetries enabled in client (window=50ms).
2) Send mixed workload: 60% short chat/generation (max_tokens=256) + 40% batched embeddings (batch size 128) over 2 minutes.
3) Observe apigw 50x concurrency spikes, hedged retry counters incrementing and upstream 502/503 responses within 30-90s.
4) Reproduce observed GPU OOMs by running multi-tenant embed burst against dedicated pool (requires staging config mirroring prod keepalive limits).

investigation_notes: Initial triage: p95 latency for apigw route rose from 120ms to 1.2s coincident with error spike; apigw hedged-retry hit rates increased 7x compared to baseline.
Correlation found between hedged retry attempts and keepalive pool exhaustion: apigw connection reuse dropped to <20% and keepalive_fd in use reached configured limit.
Runtime logs show repeated small allocation failures rather than single large allocation—consistent with memory fragmentation (frequent small model loads and model_variant swaps).
Autoscaler warmed additional ephemerals but warmup latency and accept-queue growth meant they did not absorb initial burst; increased retry traffic amplified upstream load before nodes stabilized.
Network and disk metrics normal; NVML traces show fragmentation followed by OOMs then driver-level reset on affected GPUs.
comments: Aisha Kapoor (Support) 2026-03-12: Customer reported escalation of 5xx on embedding upload job; supplied request ids and times. Asking SRE to take a look and confirm if we throttled or applied any tenant-level caps.

Ben Liang (SRE) 2026-03-12: Investigating. Early signals point to hedged retry amplification + keepalive exhaustion. I have disabled hedged retries for the tenant as an immediate mitigation and put a soft concurrency cap on ClarionAI route.

ClarionAI (Customer) 2026-03-12: Confirmed temporary reduction in errors after your change; however throughput is degraded. Can you advise why runtimes restarted? We saw several job failures with "GPU alloc failed".

Ben Liang (SRE) 2026-03-12: Runtimes logged repeated small allocation failures consistent with fragmentation; driver resets triggered restarts. We are collecting NVML dumps and flamegraphs and will onboard runtime-engineering.

Sven Müller (Runtime Eng) 2026-03-13: Collected heap allocation traces; a recent model-prefetch heuristic change increased small allocation churn (prefetch-of-variants on embed load). Rolling back candidate heuristics to reduce fragmentation. Also increasing keepalive_pool temporarly in affected prod pool.
mitigation: Applied temporary mitigations: disabled hedged retries for affected customer, applied per-tenant concurrency cap (parallelism limit), increased keepalive pool size for impacted GKE nodepool, and rolled back a model-prefetch heuristic that increased small-allocation churn.
resolution: Root cause: interaction between aggressive client-side hedged retries + apigw hedged-retry behavior and a recent runtime prefetch change causing frequent small allocations; this combination produced GPU memory fragmentation that led to OOMs and runtime restarts, amplifying 5xx rates. Remediations deployed: (1) rollback runtime prefetch heuristic (deployed canary 2026-03-13 02:40 UTC, global 03:10 UTC), (2) apigw change to add exponential backoff for hedged retries and a short jitter window (PR merged github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1128), (3) add early per-tenant concurrency caps and a stateless circuit breaker to short-circuit hammering requests. Post-deploy: customer error rate returned to baseline (~1.2% 5xx) and runtimes stopped restarting. Follow-up: runbook entry created and a postmortem scheduled.
follow_up_actions: Create postmortem doc and notify customers via status page (owner: Aisha Kapoor, due 2026-03-15).
Add automated alert for hedged-retry amplification combining apigw hedgedRetryRate and runtime keepalive_free < 10% (owner: Ben Liang).
Investigate long-term fixes: smarter runtime allocator for small allocations and per-model prefetch backoff (owner: Sven Müller).
Ship canary for apigw hedged-retry backoff to other regions in two weeks (owner: api-gateway team).
